WITH top_spenders AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, MAX(PurchasePrice) AS MaxPrice
  FROM "transaction"
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  ORDER BY MaxPrice DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.First || ' ' || c.Last AS FullName, t.CreditCardType
FROM "transaction" t
JOIN top_spenders ts ON t.CustomerID = ts.CustomerID
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.PurchasePrice = ts.MaxPrice
ORDER BY ts.MaxPrice DESC, c.First, c.Last, t.CreditCardType

- one row per: one row per product, for exactly two products: the product with the highest expected profit and the product with the lowest expected profit
- filters: none beyond selecting the highest and lowest expected-profit products; expected profit is computed as products.msrp - products.buyPrice
- aggregation: for each selected product, totalPrice must use the orderdetails row with the maximum quantityOrdered for that product; totalPrice = quantityOrdered * priceEach from that row

Hint: expected profits = SUBTRACT(msrp, buyPrice); total price = MULTIPLY(quantityOrdered, priceEach)
sql:
WITH extremes AS (
  SELECT productCode, productName, MSRP - buyPrice AS expectedProfit
  FROM products
  ORDER BY expectedProfit DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
lows AS (
  SELECT productCode, productName, MSRP - buyPrice AS expectedProfit
  FROM products
  ORDER BY expectedProfit ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM extremes
  UNION
  SELECT * FROM lows
)
SELECT s.productName,
       s.expectedProfit,
       (SELECT od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach
        FROM orderdetails od
        WHERE od.productCode = s.productCode
        ORDER BY od.quantityOrdered DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS totalPrice
FROM selected s
ORDER BY s.expectedProfit DESC;

Hint: full name refers to first_name, middle_name, last_name; born in Atlanta refers to birthCity = 'Atlanta'; the highest number of blocks refers to max(blocks); team refers to tmID
sql:
WITH player_blocks AS (
  SELECT p.playerID,
         p.firstName AS first_name,
         p.middleName AS middle_name,
         p.lastName AS last_name,
         pt.tmID,
         SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks
  FROM players p
  JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.playerID = p.playerID
  WHERE p.birthCity = 'Atlanta'
    AND pt.blocks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.playerID, p.firstName, p.middleName, p.lastName, pt.tmID
),
top_player AS (
  SELECT playerID, first_name, middle_name, last_name, SUM(total_blocks) AS player_total
  FROM player_blocks
  GROUP BY playerID, first_name, middle_name, last_name
  ORDER BY player_total DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tp.first_name || ', ' || tp.middle_name || ', ' || tp.last_name AS full_name,
       pb.tmID
FROM top_player tp
JOIN player_blocks pb ON pb.playerID = tp.playerID
ORDER BY pb.total_blocks DESC
LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Country.GovernmentForm = 'Republic' THEN Country.Code END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Country.GovernmentForm = 'ConstitutionalMonarchy' THEN Country.Code END) FROM Country JOIN CountryLanguage ON Country.Code = CountryLanguage.CountryCode WHERE CountryLanguage.Language = 'English' AND Country.GovernmentForm IN ('Republic', 'ConstitutionalMonarchy')
